summary.en: Text that takes you somewhere: an `<a href>` with `.link`, medium weight in the accent text color, the underline fading in on hover. `.link--external` adds an arrow for other sites.
summary.id: Teks yang membawa Anda ke tempat lain: `<a href>` dengan `.link`, tebal medium dalam warna teks aksen, garis bawah muncul perlahan saat hover. `.link--external` menambahkan panah untuk situs lain.

en.title: In a sentence
en.desc: Links read as part of the text. Hover to see the underline fade in.
en.html: Your request was sent to your adviser. Track its status or read the exam rules (opens in a new tab).

en.title: Under a field
en.desc: A quiet second path that leaves the form.
en.html: Forgot your password?

id.title: Di dalam kalimat
id.desc: Tautan terbaca sebagai bagian dari teks. Sorot untuk melihat garis bawah muncul.
id.html: Permohonan Anda sudah dikirim ke petugas verifikasi. Lacak statusnya atau baca syarat layanan (terbuka di tab baru).
